result.justification: The research objective is clear and well-defined, focusing on the genomic characterization of Mali's first Mpox case. The methodology is explicit and detailed, outlining various techniques and analyses performed.

evidence.quote: We report Mali’s index Mpox case, which was clinically identified at the Mali–Guinea border by the national telemedicine center and confirmed by PCR.
Time-resolved phylogenetic reconstruction and ancestral trait inference were performed with TreeTime v0.11.4.
